subject.title: feat(onboarding): enable lean mode for local models

question: Should verified Ollama and LM Studio onboarding automatically persist the experimental lean tool surface for users who did not explicitly choose it, using `wizard.localModelLeanAutoModel` as the ownership marker?
rationale: This is a deliberate new onboarding default and stored configuration contract, not a mechanical bug fix; tests can verify implementation but cannot decide whether the automatic behavior is the intended upgrade policy.

options.title: Approve onboarding-owned activation
options.body: Accept the automatic default for verified local routes, contingent on live proof that explicit values remain untouched and a later non-local route removes only the onboarding-owned setting.

options.title: Keep lean mode explicit
options.body: Retain the existing user-selected experimental flag and omit automatic writes during onboarding until a broader product decision changes that policy.

recommendation.title: Approve onboarding-owned activation
recommendation.body: Accept the automatic default for verified local routes, contingent on live proof that explicit values remain untouched and a later non-local route removes only the onboarding-owned setting.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR metadata identifies steipete as the assigned author of the proposed onboarding and configuration contract.
